text.p: Hannaford Bros Co said on Thursday that analysts' estimates for its full-year 1997 results are in line with the company's own expectations.
Hannaford released first-quarter results that included net income per share of $0.37, exactly matching the First Call consensus estimate and up $0.02 per share from the same period a year ago.
The First Call estimate for full-year 1997 is $2.07.
The company said it would increase its net selling area by more than 11 percent this year with 18 new, relocated or expanded stores.
Construction will also start on a number of stores to be opened in 1998.
Due to the planned opening schedule, Hannaford's mix of earnings in 1997 will be weighted more heavily toward the last half of the year, it said.
